problem: The active B01 branch began implementing generic motif similarity and planned family discovery that overlap qualified noncanonical CEW capabilities already present in PRs #116, #137 and #143.

decisions.reason: Existing N12-qualified non-promoting grammar already owns this responsibility.
Existing discovery layer already provides source-bound primitive candidates and opaque clustering without semantic authority.
Positive, negative and ambiguous human teaching evidence already has a governed replayable model.
Existing deterministic explainable ranking already owns generic similarity and preserves the human review boundary.
Qualified source-specific channel remains useful as one strong detector inside the union.
Feature extraction may be useful, but generic similarity/family ownership must be removed from this B01-local module.

explicitly_rejected_actions: Tune motif_similarity weights or threshold solely to make the current 0.70 synthetic score exceed 0.80
Implement a second generic project-local family-discovery subsystem in cew_b01
Implement a second generic learning-receipt schema in cew_b01
Merge historical stacked PRs wholesale without dependency reconciliation
Use literal identifiers 19 or 22, historical object counts, or manual coordinates as production detection inputs
new_work_boundary: B01 exact-source adapter into reusable primitive/prototype/similarity contracts
B01-specific high-recall proposal features/channels only where existing discovery is insufficient
deterministic candidate union, deduplication and provenance mapping
exact TAV.5 replay qualification and human review evidence
